newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales slow at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales slow at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm, USDA said. Inquiry and demand moderate. Feedlots very current.

Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 92,400 head confirmed including 17,500 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000 lbs 69.00.
Wk to date- 92,400 last week - 109,900 last year - 44,700
